mu_name_from: MuMain's _enum.h:4165: MONSTER_MODEL_ICE_MONSTER = 15, so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster{15 + 1}, Monster16.bmd; the server's type is MONSTER_ICE_MONSTER = 22 (_enum.h:4397). The client's name is 얼음괴물, ice monster (ZzzCharacter.cpp:14026). OpenMU's Version075 Devias.cs:165-193 names number 22 'Ice Monster' at level 22 with 650 health, 80-85 damage, 27 defense, MoveRange 2, AttackRange 1, ViewRange 5, AttackDelay 2000, respawn 10 s, AttackSkill Ice (Devias.cs:178). Seventy-five of them in 0-128 by 0-128 (Devias.cs:67), the quarter beside the Worms' and Assassins'.
rig_from:
Seven actions, slots 0 to 6, exported with --actions=0,1,2,3,4,5,6. Keys: 6, 6, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7; the walk is the one locked action. 38 bones, five of them dummies, and box099 on the pelvis. Bone 19 is Bip01 Head, which ZzzOpenData.cpp:3487 records as BoneHead = 19.

Play speeds are OpenMonsterModel's defaults (ZzzOpenData.cpp:2598-2603: STOP1 0.25, STOP2 0.2, WALK 0.34, ATTACK 0.33, SHOCK 0.5, DIE 0.55): 15 is not in the multiplier list and has no case in the walk-speed switch.
sheet_from: One sheet, Data/Monster/ice_m.OZJ, 128 by 128, no alpha; the .bmd's one mesh reads ice_m.jpg (424 triangles). Decoded under an icemonster_ prefix; no existing texture in source/textures matches it byte for byte.
glow_from: MU's BlendMesh 0 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:14024-14025): the one mesh drawn additive and unlit, its V scrolled -(WorldTime % 2000) * 0.0005, half a sheet a second (:6078-6080), drawn exactly so. `shadow` is ours: MU gives it none (:8668), and on Devias's snow the near-black teal sheet added to white could not be seen (the user, 2026-09-30: 'kind of hard to see ice monster' ... 'keep original but use other method to make it a little bit better visible'). The sun's shadow under it, at half strength (the user: 'reduce shadow strength specifically for that monster'), outlines it on the ground and leaves the body MU's own. content::Material::glowShadow.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the sheet at 6x: near-black teal, mottled with faceted pale-teal highlights and one grey-white blaze in the middle -- a sheet painted to be ADDED, where the black is nothing and the highlights are the light in the ice. ice for whatever of it is ever drawn lit; see glow_from for how MU draws it.
attack_skill_from: OpenMU Version075 Devias.cs:178: `AttackSkill = SkillNumber.Ice`, and mu.db's monster_kinds row 22 already carries attack_skill 7 -- OpenMU's Ice and MuMain's AT_SKILL_ICE = 7 (_enum.h:315) agree. It is still a melee blow: AttackRange 1, and OpenMU's Monster.AttackAsync (GameLogic/NPC/Monster.cs:113-123) lands a plain hit, then tries the skill's element (the hero iced, AttackableExtensions.cs:451-488) and shows the skill animation. The client answers the 0x19 packet with SetPlayerAttack and AttackTime = 1 (WSclient.cpp:4196-4219), and fifteen reference frames later draws MODEL_ICE and five MODEL_ICE_SMALL on the target and plays SOUND_ICE (ZzzCharacter.cpp:4140, :4956-4970).
effects_from: Only the V scroll (glow_from). No particles in MoveCharacterVisual beyond it, nothing in RenderCharacter's switch.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3482-3488: mIceMonster1, mIceMonster2 and mIceMonsterDie, then SetMonsterSound(..., 50, 51, 50, 50, 52) -- offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 = 210 (DSPlaySound.h:158), so 260-261 ICEMONSTER1-2 and 262 ICEMONSTERDIE. Wired as icemonster_* in sounds.json. Its Ice lands with spell_ice (sIce.wav), the wizard's own.
islands_from: One welded island of 424 triangles, all of it the glow sheet. The build fills this.
